output.answer: The ambulance service can obtain network-status information from the operator during an emergency through the legal channels established by Federal Decree-Law No. (35) of 2024 On the Reorganization of the Civil Defence [U1]. However, it is not explicitly stated that this law covers real-time network-status information requests in emergencies. The QoS Policy also provides some regulatory framework but focuses more on service standards and quality rather than specific emergency procedures [U3].
